description: This is a C# source file defining the Order entity class within the application's core domain. The class models an order with properties such as BuyerId, OrderDate, ShipToAddress, and a collection of OrderItems. It includes constructors, encapsulation practices, and a method to calculate the total order cost.

classes.name: Order
classes.description: Represents a customer order with properties for buyer identification, order date, shipping address, and order items. It encapsulates order item management and total calculation logic.

methods.name: Order
methods.description: Constructor initializing a new order with buyer ID, shipping address, and list of order items. Uses guard clause to ensure buyer ID is not null or empty.

methods.name: Total
methods.description: Calculates the total cost of the order by summing the product of unit price and units for each order item.
